fact: On 1 October 2024 the ICT ministry's director general of IT said about 120,000 Tunisians held a digital identity, used to log into portals of the social affairs, interior and state property ministries, for remote school and university registration and for e-payment card issuance.
title: مديرة بوزارة تكنولوجيات الإتصال: "120 ألف تونسي يملكون هوية رقمية"
